description: Return a normalized side-by-side comparison of two to ten ETFs across selected classification, market, fund-data, cost, income, benchmark, price-performance, price-risk, holdings, and optional overlap modules. Include overlap to measure pairwise shared securities and weighted overlap from latest stored holdings, matched by security identity rather than ticker alone; cash, currency and derivatives are excluded. Missing holdings make overlap unavailable, while partial holdings make it a lower bound. Only requested modules run; overlap alone fetches no price history. Leaders are mechanical extrema, not recommendations. Currency, holdings dates and coverage caveats are explicit. Read-only.

include.description: Selected comparison modules. overlap is opt-in and returns pairwise shared holdings and weighted overlap from each fund's latest stored snapshot.

performanceDays.description: Window in calendar days back from each fund's newest close; the start is the last close on or before that day. 365 matches the fund page and the screener's 1-year return.

tickers.description: Two to ten exact Bullrun ETF listing tickers.

topSharedLimit.description: Maximum shared holdings per ETF pair when overlap is requested; does not limit the snapshots used in overlap calculations.

name: compare_etfs
